hook.text: Your servers are in Virginia. Users in Sydney experience 300ms latency just from distance.

buildup.text: Multi-region deploys copies of your service in data centers around the world.

discovery.text: Users are routed to the nearest region. A request from Tokyo hits the Tokyo data center, not Virginia.

twist.text: Keeping data in sync across regions is the hardest part. Conflict resolution is an unsolved general problem.

climax.text: Multi-region reduces latency and improves availability but multiplies operational complexity.

quiz.question: What is the biggest challenge of multi-region architecture?
options: Keeping data in sync across regions
